BiblicalUsage: Ashes are the sign of repentance and the means of cleansing. Tyre and Sidon would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes, and under the law the ashes of an heifer sprinkling the unclean sanctified to the purifying of the flesh.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ashes preach both ways: they mark the sorrow that turns, and they point to the cleansing that only blood can finish.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
